title: Public Alert No. 037/2026 – Alert on Suspected Counterfeit Pulmicort® (Budesonide) Inhalation Suspension

products.manufacturer: Legency Remedies PVT Ltd, Vill Kalha Baddi, Tehsil Baddi, Distt Solan (H.P) 173205, India

summary: NAFDAC warns of a suspected counterfeit "Ulmicort 0.5 mg/ml Inhalation Suspension" found in Eastern Nigeria, mimicking AstraZeneca's registered Pulmicort (budesonide). Batch 25770416E, labelled made by Legency Remedies PVT Ltd, India. Buy only from licensed pharmacies.
